verdict_rationale: The cycle's single substantive claim is a real falsification of the lane's own instrument, reproduced by the auditor in both directions under the exact failing condition rather than a simulation; the fix is minimal and moves no frozen threshold, token, budget, question, gate success rule or recorded verdict; the instrument remains falsifiable under five independent attacks; every recorded negative survives byte-for-byte; the three regression tests are non-vacuous; and producer state honestly marks the lane question complete with human_gate_ready false. The five defects found are prose/metadata corrections that cannot alter any verdict or scientific content, consistent with the house precedent that passed CYCLE_38934722443 with an equivalent cosmetic count slip, so they are recorded as minor observations rather than escalating an honest negative cycle to REVISE. The recurring systemic condition (three stacked unpromoted proposals, re-dispatch of a completed question) is a control-plane/portfolio defect the producer diagnosed but cannot fix, and is not grounds to block this cycle; it is escalated here as a required portfolio disposition.
